summary: LocationRef normalised from a live Open-Meteo geocoding record for Bangkok, showing how a provider result maps onto the canonical shape.

provenance.license: Open-Meteo API terms — CC BY 4.0 for the geocoding dataset (GeoNames derived)
provenance.attribution: Geocoding by Open-Meteo, data derived from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0)
provenance.redaction: none — the record describes a city and contains no personal data. Coordinates are rounded to 4 decimal places (about 11 m), which is the precision this contract keeps for a place rather than a person.
provenance.notes: confirmed_by_user is false because a provider result is only a suggestion; the traveller must accept the pin before it can be used in an assessment.
